reason: The paper is carefully scoped and attributes the telescoping, time-varying-potential and terminal-potential steps to Lu et al., Devlin and Kudenko, and Grześ as the search record supports; its main theorem, the triangle-inequality split and the softmax signal bound are correct, and no reference looks invented. However, the active-only boundary display is inconsistent with the paper's own embedding. Under that embedding the exit term vanishes when the exit transition is paid, which undercuts the entry-and-exit and Grześ statements and leaves the conclusion contradicting Section 4. The other corrections are presentational: pipeline-internal wording, undefined notation, one sentence stronger than the ledger, and bibliography rendering and in-text handling of the two uncatalogued prior works.
